guarantee.h2: Why Patients Really Leave Your Website Without Booking
guarantee.body:
When a patient lands on your site, they're making an emotional decision rather than a logical one. Which means they're not really reading your pages, but scanning them for reasons to feel safe. The moment something interrupts that feeling, they close the page and don't push through. For example: when people visit your site, they want to see the outcome they can expect, not the fancy new machine you're using. If your before-and-after gallery clearly shows those outcomes, that's the evidence they need. If it doesn't, they feel less certain, and an uncertain patient doesn't book.
And it makes total sense! When someone is about to spend four or five figures on a procedure, they want to be 100% sure about it. That's why the Patient-Leak System makes sure that trust is kept. Here's how to use it:

How could we provide clinic owners with true value without guesswork or burning another thousand bucks on a PDF template? So we decided to find a different way. After spending €550,000+ on different patient funnel approaches, we were able to build a system that shows you exactly what we spent years learning. That's why our Patient-Leak System allows you to use all our knowledge tailored to your clinic’s specific case. Agencies usually charge four figures for audits built from templates. This one is only $27, and it's built for your site. See below to learn how it works in detail:

guarantee.h2: Here’s What That Means For You And Your Clinic
guarantee.body: Every clinic is built on one thing and one thing only - its ability to generate revenue. And revenue is largely based on the ability to get patients. Generating patients is also the #1 expense a clinic will incur on its path to growth. That's why we developed the Patient-Leak System model, to help you recover the patients your website is currently losing... and turn the traffic you already pay for into booked appointments. How far you scale is up to you. Here are a few of our clients and their stories of what they’ve been able to accomplish with the help of the Patient-Leak System.

onlySystem.h2: The Only System You’ll Need To Acquire Patients

guarantee.body: Your diagnosis will be specific to your clinic's case. It will name the exact signals missing from your site, benchmark them against clinics in your vertical, and tell you what to fix first. If it reads like something that could have been written for any clinic on the internet, call us out on it. We mean that. And if your diagnosis doesn't contain at least one actionable finding you can use this week, we refund your $27 in full.

items.a:
The Patient-Leak System was built for clinic owners and practice decision-makers running medium-to-high ticket healthcare services. Dental implant, All-on-4/6, aesthetic, med spa, and physiotherapy clinics specifically.
If you are a general practitioner, a pharmacy, or a clinic outside those verticals, this is not the right fit and we will tell you that during submission.

Honestly, it's a filter, not a profit center. When the audit was open to everyone, most of them were never implemented. The $27 keeps it limited to clinic owners who are serious about fixing what we find, and it doesn't even cover what the analysis costs us to run. And if it turns out we're wrong about your site, the money back guarantee means it costs you nothing anyway

You submit your clinic's website URL directly, and our system deeply analyses it against 14 healthcare-specific signals for your vertical.
Nothing in your diagnosis is written for "clinics in general." It is written for your URL, your vertical, and the market you operate in.

items.q: 🔹 I've had marketing audits before. Why is this different?
items.a:
Because this isn't a marketing audit.
Most audits tell you to create more content, more ads, etc. The Patient-Leak System tells you what's already broken. The 14 signals we check are the specific technical, structural, and psychological barriers that stop patients from booking even when your ads are working.
We're basically telling you what to fix.

items.q: 🔹 How long does it take to get my diagnosis?
items.a:
Your first finding arrives within minutes of submitting.
The second arrives on day 2. The third on day 3.
We space them deliberately, one finding at a time is actionable. 
Three findings at once becomes a to-do list nobody finishes. Trust us, we tried that.
Yes. If your diagnosis does not contain at least one specific, actionable finding you can implement this week, reply to any of the emails and we refund your $27 in full.
